# Pinned SDK headers

The SDK headers in this directory are copied unchanged from these upstream revisions:

- VirtualSMC 1.3.8, commit `b15991dd87e36a102bf159ea56490e3126245590`; see `LICENSE.VirtualSMC.txt`.
- Lilu 1.6.9, commit `8e8eb256c5d8fa50d44b49255a55f093132d2f25`; see `LICENSE.Lilu.txt`.

Only the public headers required by `VirtualSMCSDK/kern_vsmcapi.hpp` are included.
Apple kernel headers come from the active Xcode SDK's `Kernel.framework/Headers`.
